content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe is heavily restricted, digital creators are forced to abandon their online stores or accept high fees when processing payments. However, by using Supabase as the order database for digital stores, creators can break free from the constraints of Stripe and other payment platforms. With this infrastructure, creators can accept [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-3|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|crypto]] payments for free and host their digital product stores on GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-2|Cloudflare R2]] Pages, giving them full control over their online presence. This guide shows you how to deploy Supabase as the order database for digital stores and explains the advantages of this infrastructure solution.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to this infrastructure's success lies in its use of open-source tools and the flexibility of Supabase as an order database. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Supabase for order storage, digital creators can avoid the high fees and restrictions imposed by payment platforms like Stripe. Furthermore, the combination of NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery provides a seamless and secure payment experience for customers. This infrastructure is designed to be scalable and customizable, allowing creators to adapt it to their specific needs and grow their online businesses with confidence.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying Supabase as the order database for digital stores, you will need a few essential tools and a basic understanding of how they work together. These include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for order storage, NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. You will also need to have a basic understanding of how to use these tools and how to integrate them with each other. This guide assumes that you have a basic knowledge of how to use these tools and will focus on providing step-by-step instructions for deploying Supabase as the order database for digital stores.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying Supabase as the order database for digital stores. This involves integrating NOWPayments with Supabase and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and configuring the payment and delivery settings to work seamlessly together. This section will walk you through the process of setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, including how to integrate NOWPayments with Supabase and configure the payment and delivery settings.
Supabase is the backbone of this infrastructure, providing a flexible and scalable solution for managing orders, customers, and products.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you are ready to go live and process your first transaction. This involves testing your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it is working correctly and that you are able to process transactions smoothly. This section will walk you through the process of going live and processing your first transaction, including how to test your payment and delivery pipeline and troubleshoot any issues that may arise.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Supabase as the order database for digital stores, follow these steps: Choose a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up your account. Install Supabase as the order database for digital stores and configure the payment and delivery settings. Integrate NOWPayments with Supabase and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless payment and delivery. Test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it is working correctly. Go live and process your first transaction. Monitor your infrastructure's performance and identify areas for improvement. Scale your infrastructure as needed to meet the demands of your growing online business.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Supabase and how does it work as an order database for digital stores?

Supabase is an open-source, cloud-based database that allows you to store and manage data for your digital store. It provides a flexible and scalable solution for managing orders, customers, and products, and integrates seamlessly with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
Can I use Supabase with other payment platforms besides NOWPayments?
Yes, you can use Supabase with other payment platforms, but NOWPayments provides a seamless and secure payment experience for customers, making it the recommended choice for digital stores.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with Supabase and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2?

Integrating NOWPayments with Supabase and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 involves setting up API keys and configuring the payment and delivery settings to work seamlessly together. This process is outlined in the setup section of this guide.
What are the benefits of using Supabase as the order database for digital stores?

Using Supabase as the order database for digital stores provides a flexible and scalable solution for managing orders, customers, and products, and allows you to break free from the constraints of Stripe and other payment platforms.
Can I deploy Supabase as the order database for digital stores on my own or do I need professional help?

You can deploy Supabase as the order database for digital stores on your own, but if you're not familiar with the tools and setup process, it's recommended to seek professional help to ensure a smooth and successful deployment.
